items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: You know I’ve used Bennie Maupin and he’s great. I’m still in touch with Bennie.

ctx.x: I imagine like most working musicians you have a list of players and you have your first choices and your second choices on every instrument.

I do. That’s very important. Yeah. I mean usually I use Jay Anderson on bass. I’m very comfortable playing with Jay. And drummers that’s a little different, because I’ve worked with Matt Wilson a bunch but I’ve also worked with Adam Nussbaum a bunch. And so you know I’ve used Adam when I’ve gone on tour and so yeah, I have several musicians that I picked. And as far as tenor players or something like that, that’s the same thing. You know I’ve used Bennie Maupin and he’s great. I’m still in touch with Bennie.
Is he a New York person?
